answer.rationale: Roll out shorter onboarding across self-serve SMB accounts. Confirmed evidence shows faster time-to-value, higher completion, and a 3% retention lift, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Avoid promotional pricing: although acquisition rose, the verified cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive renewal. This does not prove onboarding will neutralize the competitor’s price cut, but it is the strongest validated option aligned with long-term value.
